verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of AI triage is the founder's HN description of Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes and summarizes threads, plus a README line that it is 'AI Driven' with agents and LLMs. The MCP label and archive tools are building blocks an external agent would drive, not built-in triage, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented auto-labeling behavior, surfacing of what needs attention or priority, user steering of triage rules, an audit trail of AI actions, first-party docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
AI Driven** - Enhance your emails with Agents & LLMs.
